historical_references.context: Narendra was a contemporary of Chaitanya Mahaprabhu, a prominent figure in the Bhakti movement in India.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Narendra was a 12th-century Jain monk and scholar who wrote a commentary on the Agama texts. The name Narendar carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Narendra's commentary, known as the Saraswati-kalpa, was considered a major contribution to Jain scholarship.
